gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-nobile: Nulshock stretches its wide, spaced-out capitals along one unshaded outline, with every curve as stout as a stem. Nobile, a plain sans, stays compact beneath it.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-nokora: Nokora lays down a dense, dark band of lowercase. Nulshock's stretched, technical letters look like machined signage above it, with no thin hairlines anywhere in its a.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Stretched and stout, like cut lengths of cord. Noto Kufi Arabic follows with a gap-toothed c and modest capitals, giving the sans a gentler, more modern hum under Nulshock's bold technical lettering.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-noto-sans: Noto Sans reads with large lowercase bodies and a generous c. Over a full page it would feel easygoing and contemporary, while Nulshock's rope-like strokes stay up in the headline.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Noto Sans Adlam keeps its curve endings well apart, so the sans-serif reads open. Nulshock earns its keep big and brief, where every diagonal is as stout as an upright.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-noto-sans-adlam-u: Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined reads modern and businesslike, leaving generous space between curve ends and stems. Nulshock, meanwhile, excels at bold, uninterrupted monoline strokes, and the plain sans body excels at quiet, steady text.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-noto-sans-anatoli: Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs reads modern and tall, its x-height climbing near cap height with tips pointing outward. Nulshock's strongest quality is its solder-through-a-nozzle strokes, which feel nothing like that plain sans.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Every Nulshock stroke ends at one measured thickness, stretched wide and technical. Noto Sans Arabic, a plain sans with a pronounced x-height and wide openings, would read smoothly through a long page.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-noto-sans-armenia: Nulshock is stretched, bold and technical, with almost no stroke contrast. Noto Sans Armenian, a sans-serif with tall, full c, s and z, would read approachably over a long passage.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-noto-sans-avestan: Nulshock holds the constant weight of a stencil-cut channel, stretched wide with spacious tracking and bold, technical presence. Noto Sans Avestan, a plain sans, reads cleanly on and on.
